items.title: Veralto (VLTO) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Q2 Guidance And Analyst Target Lifts
items.summary: Veralto’s fair value estimate has shifted to about US$112.76 from about US$108.06, giving investors an updated reference point for where analysts see the stock today. Many recent research notes link these higher price targets to Q2 2026 results, refreshed guidance and steady Water Quality demand, even as some investors question how much upside is already reflected. items.title: VLTO Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center Tailwinds and Industrial Growth Drive Outlook
items.summary: Water analytics and treatment company Veralto (NYSE:VLTO) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $1.47 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.11 per share was 10.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Veralto’s (NYSE:VLTO) Q2 CY2026 Non-GAAP EPS Beat Estimates
items.summary: Water analytics and treatment company Veralto (NYSE:VLTO) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $1.47 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.11 per share was 10.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
